title: Austrian expedition to Brazil
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Austrian expedition to Brazil", at revision 1372593374, opens: "The Austrian expedition to Brazil was a scientific expedition which explored Brazil. It was organized and financed by the Austrian Empire from 1817 to 1835." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q301417, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "political and scientific mission to Brazil from Austria (1817–1835)". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
